name: SubsSupportPro
description:
An upgrade of the previous SubsSupport plugin.
The main new features :
* It is different name , different package .

* It is completely skinned for HD and FHD .
* Add only the working providers
>>> API key providers : subdl , subsource , opensubtitle , Wyzie .

>>> Free providers : subf2m , Subtitlesmora , novalermora , localdrive .
* Add support for provider logo .
* Add color themes : 'Ember, Arctic, Royal, Graphite, Aurora, Neon, Sunset'

* Add Locale Translator tool , thanks Lululla
* New country flags .
* Show update status in main screen .

* It supports both python 2 and python 3 for opensource images only
IPK download
